requirements.title: Viewer layers and their defaults
requirements.statement: The viewer has toggleable layers. On by default: 360 video walks, pinpoints, 360 images, phone images, drone panoramas, zones, asset names, notes, drone images, laser and phone video walks. Off by default: capture coverage, progress, heat maps, daily notes and annotations. The progress layer shows only to users with view-asset (or prime users). Zones show only on projects flagged for zone progress.

requirements.title: When the zone heat map can be turned on
requirements.statement: The PRD allows the heat map only in the sheet (design) view, only in Delta mode, only when zones are shown, and disables it when any selected stage has no takeoff. The code offers it in sheet and sheet-sheet views to users who can see progress on zone-progress projects, without checking Delta mode or missing takeoff.

dispute.summary: The PRD disables the heat map outside Delta mode and when a stage lacks takeoff. The code checks neither; a missing takeoff counts as 0% and colours the zone red. Product must set the rules (DEC-036, DEC-008).

requirements.title: How the heat map colours zones
requirements.statement: Each zone's value is the average percent complete across the selected stages. Colours run from red (lowest) to green (highest), rescaled to the lowest and highest values among the zones shown. A zone with no progress that has never started is grey and is left out of the scale. A started zone at 0% is red. A zone at 100% or more is green. If all zones have the same value, all are green.
requirements.rationale: The PRD (AC-005, AC-006) also normalises across the shown zones and greys out zones with no data, so the base rule agrees.

requirements.title: Heat map tooltip, legend and stalled zones
requirements.statement: With the heat map on, a legend shows bottom-right. Hovering a zone shows its name and percent progress for the selected date range. A zone with 0 progress across all categories and stages is tagged "Stalled" in the deepest red, distinct from the least-progressed active zone. With exactly one zone selected, it keeps its default colour.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only for the "Stalled" tag and single-zone rule; neither was found in the heat map code.

requirements.title: Overlay BIM on a reality
requirements.statement: The PRDs ask that users can overlay the BIM model on the reality view, toggle it and adjust its opacity. Today the BIM overlay button is shown only to support users, only on the left side, and never in production.

dispute.summary: visualization-overlays FR-003 and gaussian-splat FR-005 are must-haves for users. The code limits BIM overlay to support users outside production, and checks view-bim-type rather than the seeded bim-overlay permission. Product must say whether BIM overlay ships to customers (DEC-035).

requirements.title: Overlay floor plans on the drone map, with opacity
requirements.statement: On the drone map, users can turn on a design overlay, pick which designs to show, and set their opacity. The opacity control is disabled until a design is selected.
requirements.rationale: The PRD asks for uploaded PDF floor plans picked from a dropdown. The code reads one prepared design-overlays.json per structure; how PDFs become that file was not traced.

requirements.title: Overlay shapefiles and DXF files
requirements.statement: Users can upload a shapefile floor plan and overlay it on the drone orthophoto, and upload a DXF file and overlay it on the selected sheet.
requirements.rationale: PRD-only. No shapefile or DXF overlay handling, and no /api/v1/upload/dxf endpoint, was found in the code read.
